method: Independent URI resolution, original configuration/lock digests, frozen/current project bytes and harness hashes; no project collector or auditor imported and no Dart runtime executed.
limitations: Current files and frozen Git objects corroborate recorded collection metadata; this is not an independent capture of all bytes at execution time.
Installed dependency source bytes and SDK/AOT executable bytes are not hashed in these records.
Source bit semantics and test coverage are reviewed separately; benchmark work equality is not a serialized bitwise replay of every geometry output.
